definitions.explanation: A male and a female animal, usually birds, that have paired up to breed. Also counts such pairs: ひとつがい (one pair).

examples.english: A pair of swallows built a nest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やって{来|き}た→やって来る：17013_yattekuru⟧ひとつがい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペンギン→ペンギン：06500_pengin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: A chick was born to the pair of penguins that came to the zoo.

notes:
Usually written in kana; the kanji spelling {番|つが}い is rare. Used mostly of birds and small animals kept in pairs; for people, ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧ or ⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧ is the normal word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つがい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to pair up, to mate
- ひとつがい: one pair (of animals)
- つがい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧: a pair of birds
- つがい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep (animals) as a pair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧: married couple — of people
- ⟦{雌雄|しゆう}→雌雄：32032_shiyuu⟧: male and female — the two sexes, as in biology
